fact: In July 2024 the Ministry of Commerce and Industry stated LBR processes are largely walk-in and paper-based on a staff-only LAN system, and tendered an online registration system integrating LRA tax registration, NASSCORP and NIR, with beneficial ownership collection at registration.
title: Terms of Reference for the Development of an Online Business Registration System for the Liberia Business Registry
publisher: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Republic of Liberia
